datasets.purpose: Acutely Food Insecure Population Estimates in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys to estimate acutely food insecure populations across Yemen under different scenarios. The most likely scenario estimates were compiled into a time series dataset for 2019, representing modeled food insecurity impact derived from field assessments and analysis.
